title: SCA Minhag of the Week 169: "Introduction to the Sebbit"

chapters.title: Etymology of the Sebet
chapters.about: Origin of the word from the Arabic sept

summary: Mr. Arking introduces the Sebet as a grand Shabbat celebration held to mark happy life cycle occasions. He explains that the term originates from the Arabic word for Shabbat and discusses how the tradition is rooted in Syrian customs of food and music.
questions: What is the origin of the word Sebet?
What makes the Syrian Sebet unique?
How has the location of the Sebet changed in recent years?
